title: Components that aren't in the storyboard are still linked from the documentation
body:
**Bug: What is the current behavior?**

All components have a link to "show in storyboard", which links to the storyboard without a selected component

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**

Components that aren't featured in the storyboard don't have a "view in storyboard" link

**Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?**

All

**What project are you opening an issue for?**
- react-instantsearch
